attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Creates a ribbon, Copyright (C) 2018 Orkhan Ashrafov.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetParent: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- Equal: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- Ctrls: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 5).
- Joints: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 5).
- Constraint: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- AddFk: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- CtrlOrientation: SurfaceNormal keeps the default follicle orientation (Z follows surface normal). WorldForward orients controls and joints so Z faces world-forward and Y faces world-up.
- Template parent examples: Spine_End_Jnt, Head_Jnt, L_Wrist_Jnt.

Tips:
- if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly.
